name: Fan Board
description: Wall-mounted fans blow falling marbles sideways, delaying when they reach the belt without changing where they end up.
howToPlay: Tap the four boxes. The pink (col 3) and blue (col 5) marbles fall past a fan and swerve, so they reach the belt a beat later than the green and orange marbles that drop straight down. Fans change timing, never destination.
author: Claude
